headline: Fidelity Bank Appoints Stanley Amuchie as Managing Director
summary: Nigeria's Fidelity Bank named Stanley Amuchie as managing director to succeed retiring chief executive Nneka Onyeali-Ikpe, supporting the bank's next phase of growth.
why: Fidelity Bank is one of Nigeria's prominent commercial lenders; leadership transitions guide capital mobilization and regional business expansion.

impacts.name: Fidelity Bank Nigeria
impacts.why: A new chief executive appointment steers long-term executive strategy and banking growth.
